reply.subject: Regarding your recent order for Pike & Sons Ltd
reply.body: I have received your order request. Unfortunately, we cannot proceed with processing your order at this time. Please address the following points so we can move forward: 1. Your account is currently on hold; please contact our accounts department to resolve this. 2. Please provide the delivery address for this order. 3. Please clarify if you still require delivery 'today', noting that this is subject to the account hold being lifted. Once these items are resolved, I will be able to confirm stock availability and provide an estimated delivery date.
